{{Quote|Well, what do ya know? I ain't seen one of these since I was prospecting on Subterrel, beyond the Outer Rim!|[[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]]|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''Subterrel''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] within the [[Subterrel sector/Legends|Subterrel sector]] beyond the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], widely known for its extensive mining operations.

Numerous beings worked in the mines, including a large labor force of [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]]-created clones, known as [[shovel-handed miner]]s. At some point, [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] spent time prospecting on the planet. Just prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jettster told [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] that the last time he had seen a Kaminoan [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|saberdart]] was in a mine on Subterrel.
